Thanks, Maya — quick clarifying Qs before we can move INV-10294 off hold: 

- The invoice is billed to "Greenspire Holdings, Inc." but the PDF is for "Greenspire LLC". Do you have documentation that ties the two legal names (DBA, acquisition notice, or consolidation paperwork)?

Rishi / Maya — adding our acceptance checklist so everyone is aligned. Short version: we need proof that the certificate covers the legal entity on the invoice or a legal tie between entities plus an authorization letter.

Minimal checklist (what will clear the hold):
- Copy of W-9 or equivalent tax form for the billed entity (matching EIN).
- Signed company letter on letterhead stating: "Greenspire Holdings, Inc. dba Greenspire LLC is the same economic entity for purposes of resale exemptions for goods/services supplied to Redwood Inference."
- Signatory name and title + contact (preferably CFO).
- If names differ, an affidavit or DocuSign-signed acquisition/merger notice or DBA filing that validates the relationship.

For TX/CA we sometimes require notarization; for most other states an emailed signed letter and matching EIN + certificate are acceptable. If you can provide the affidavit (attached example), we can likely release INV-10294 after a quick internal peer review.

Attachment: resale-acceptance-checklist.pdf

Thanks — looping in Priyom if we need a TaxOps exception.

—Lauren Bishop
Billing Operations — Redwood Inference
